info.title: pushover-notifications
info.description: The routes pushover-notifications serves. Every path is relative to the mount the host assigns, and the host serves this document rebased under it at <mount>/openapi.json.

post.description: Sends one message with the current credentials, so a person can tell they work. The host takes operate_resource on the module's instance before this is called. Refused with 409 NOT_CONFIGURED while pushover_token and pushover_user are empty, and with 502 SEND_FAILED, carrying Pushover's reason, when Pushover does not take it.
